notes: Decoder with last-token pooling: the tokenizer appends <|endoftext|> (example_tokens) and the pooled vector is the hidden state of that last real token. tokenizer.json is byte-identical in the ONNX and PyTorch repos.
PyTorch right-pads and takes position (attention_mask.sum - 1); batched cosine is 1.0, so the padding side of the batch does not matter as long as pooling uses the mask.
Weights are bfloat16 on disk (torch_weight_MB is the download size) and about 2.4 GB in fp32 memory; transformers upcasts them exactly.

max_length 32768 is the ONNX repo's tokenizer_config.json value; the corpus reaches 2135 tokens and a 32k-token probe was not attempted (tens of GB of attention scores in the ONNX graph), so the limit itself is not exercised.
fastembed ran at batch size 1, chosen up front to bound attention memory; the default batch size was not tried.
